summary: Shows using _task.result in until without registering, waiting for several services to be active.
questions: How do I wait for each systemd service to be active in a loop?
Can I use until without register?

answer_card.title: until with _task.result
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.command: systemctl is-active {{ item }}
  loop: [nginx, postgresql, redis]
  retries: 5
  delay: 2
  until: _task.result.rc == 0
```
